thread:
Ara: Quick flag — there's 3 PRs in the docs queue using mixed param names: `model_id`, `modelId`, and the newer param-case `model-id`. This is breaking a couple of SDK snippet tests. Can we standardize on `model-id` across docs/snippets?
Jamal: +1 to standardize. We landed param-case in the glossary last quarter, right? makes sense to enforce. Which PRs are affected?
Ara: #2489, #2492, #2501. Example in #2492:
```
# old snippet
client.generate(model_id="redwood-1", prompt="hi")

# desired
client.generate(model-id="redwood-1", prompt="hi")
```
Sophia: I can sweep the Python / JS snippets this afternoon. I'll leave comments on the PRs for clarity.
Matt: I can add a quick docs CI check that runs a regex to fail on `model_id` or `modelId` in /docs/snippets and examples. Low risk.
Jamal: Nice — can we also add a link to the glossary entry in the PR template so authors notice param-case?
Ara: Yes — maybe a short note: "Use param-case for runtime params (see /docs/glossary#param-case)". Keep it minimal.
DocsBot: heads-up: docs linter failed on #2492 (snippet mismatch). Re-run after edits.
Sophia: For JS snippets I'll update:
```
// old
await client.generate({ modelId: 'redwood-1', input: 'hi' })

// new
await client.generate({ 'model-id': 'redwood-1', input: 'hi' })
```
Matt: FYI the CI check will be implemented as: grep -R "\bmodel_id\b|\bmodelId\b" docs/ || true then fail if matches. I'll open a tiny PR to the docs CI today.
Ara: Also spotted a couple of microcopy inconsistencies: some pages still say "Model ID" while we prefer "model-id" in inline code, but human-facing copy should stay as "model ID" where it reads nicer. Let's be deliberate: code/config use param-case, prose can be "model ID".
Jamal: Good call — add that as a single line in the style guide under "parameter naming". I can draft it.
Sophia: Assigning myself to #2489 and #2492 updates. I'll ping maintainers once done.
Matt: I'll post the CI PR link here when ready.
DocsBot: reminder: please include a changelog entry for docs-breaking snippet fixes if the public snippet URL changed.
Ara: Thanks all — rough plan: 1) Sophia updates snippets in the 3 PRs, 2) Matt adds the CI regex, 3) Jamal drafts the tiny style-guide blurb and PR template note. We should have quick reviews and merge today if no regressions. :thumbsup:
Sophia: on it.
Matt: working on CI now.
Jamal: I'll draft the style blurb and drop it into /docs/style.md by EOD.
Ara: Closing loop — once merged, let's run the snippet test job full run to catch any remaining cases.
DocsBot: job queued: docs-snippet-test (post-merge run).
